name: 타르한 · 저승길 차림
hair: 진홍색과 검은색이 섞인 길고 거친 머리카락
outfit: 금색 장식이 박힌 진홍색 가죽 갑옷과 두꺼운 북유럽풍 모피 망토
silhouette: 거대한 모피 망토와 길게 뻗은 곡도의 비대칭적 실루엣, 육중한 체구
signature_motion: 곡도를 크게 휘두르며 주변에 은빛 잔상을 남기는 회전 베기
signature_vfx: 검은 달의 형태를 그리며 퍼져나가는 진홍색 달빛 파동
visual_en: A massive silhouette featuring a heavy crimson fur cloak adorned with lavish golden ornaments. The character has pale frost-colored skin and long, coarse hair in deep crimson and black. A large, glowing silver scimitar is held in one hand, reflecting a bright lunar light. The eyes are piercing silver-blue. At the waist, a small silver dagger with a tiny ruby glints. The heavy boots are reinforced with metallic studs, and a golden lunar pendant hangs prominently over the dark leather armor. Faint frost particles drift from the heavy hem of the cloak.
features_en: Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing tall and imposing, poised to strike with a heavy, menacing stance.
vfx_en: A crescent-shaped wave of deep crimson and silver light expanding outwards.

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.
